author: phantomopr6767
quote: 10/10. This remake is how you do it right. Best performance I've seen, smooth, sharp, loads fast, and it just feels complete. Nothing cut, nothing half done, the whole game is here and it plays better than ever. The world, the music, the dungeons, all of it hits exactly like it should, but without the old frustrations. This is the complete experience, the version to play. If you only play one Zelda, play this. 10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: phantomopr6767
quote: 8/10. The original God of War still hits hard. For its time this was pure innovation, the Blades of Chaos combat, the scale of the Greek world, Kratos tearing through gods and monsters like nothing else on PS2. It made action games feel brutal and cinematic at the same time, and the story of Kratos actually got me invested. Yeah, the graphics are dated now, the camera can be annoying, and some puzzles drag, but the ideas and the combat are still better than a lot of games today. A classic that started it all, just not perfect anymore. 8/10.

author: phantomopr6767
quote: 0/10. Total joke. Ten years of hype for this broken mess? Crashes, NPCs freezing, cars vanishing, frame drops every time you get into the city. And for what, a game that is digital only, no physical copy to even own, and half the good stuff locked behind the premium edition paywall. Rockstar sold us a trailer, not a finished game. The media calling this a masterpiece is a lie, they clearly did not play the launch version. I paid full price for a beta. Do not buy this until they fix it, and even then the premium locked items are still a scam. Worst GTA ever, 0/10.
